verdict.rationale: Document AI ships a Document QnA feature that combines OCR with an LLM so users can ask natural-language questions and even do multi-document comparisons, which is a narrow form of delegating a task to an embedded AI capability — but this is scoped strictly to querying document content, not a general-purpose built-in assistant that can take broader actions inside the product. Missing for 10: evidence of a persistent, interactive assistant/agent UI within the product, ability to delegate multi-step or cross-feature tasks (not just Q&A), and any community/hands-on confirmation of using it as an 'assistant' rather than an API call.
